title: Antucura NV Chérie Sparkling Pinot Noir Rosé Sparkling (Vista Flores)
description: Strawberry, field grass and creamy, lactic aromas feed into a bright palate with ripe but short flavors of melon and spiced apple.

title: Trapiche NV Extra Brut Sparkling (Mendoza)
description: Aggressive and ultra-bubbly, with gassy apple, pear and pineapple aromas.

title: Domaine Jean Bousquet NV Brut Methode Traditionnelle  (Tupungato)
description: The nose is yeasty with aromas of apple and hay stalks.

title: Viniterra NV Método Tradicional Extra Brut  (Mendoza)
description: Given the local competition, this Pinot Noir-dominated sparkler is pretty good.

title: Familia Schroeder NV Deseado Sparkling (Argentina)
description: The nose on this Patagonian sparkler is a stand-in for Moscato, although by all indications this is made from Torrontés.

title: Alma Negra NV Brut Nature Rosé Sparkling (Mendoza)
description: This salmon-colored, no-dosage bubbly is peachy, dusty and yeasty on the nose, with strong whiffs of sulfur and scrambled egg.

title: Pascual Toso NV Toso Brut Sparkling (Mendoza)
description: Grassy floral aromas are aromatic but unrefined.

title: Spirit of the Andes NV Sustainably Farmed Sparkling Torrontés (Tupungato)
description: Moscato-like with its jasmine and lychee aromas, but things fall apart in the mouth.

title: Cruzat NV Cuvée Réserve Extra Brut  (Mendoza)
description: Citrus and stone-fruit aromas struggle to hold up, while the palate on this blend of 75% Pinot Noir and 25% Chardonnay is solid but soft.

title: Baja Tanga NV Sparkling Sec Cuvée Rosé Sparkling (Mendoza)
description: Candied, dusty aromas turn sweet and soapy if given time.

title: Alta Vista 2016 Malbec Rosé (Mendoza)
description: Aromas of dish soap and fruit salad show on the nose while the palate brings pink grapefruit and orange.

title: Zolo 2017 Sustainably Farmed Estate Grown and Bottled Rosé (Mendoza)
description: This youthful pink-colored number smells of dusty cherry and Lifesavers.

title: François Lurton 2015 Piedra Negra Pinot Gris Alta Colección Rosado (Uco Valley)
description: Salmon-colored and spritzy, this rosé of Pinot Grigio smells stony and peachy.

title: Caligiore 2010 Pianissimo Rosé (Mendoza)
description: Heavy and stalky smelling, with burnt aromas.

title: Kaiken 2010 Rosé of Malbec Rosé (Mendoza)
description: Generic on the nose, with undistinguished aromas of red fruits and candy.

title: Zorzal 2016 Terroir Único Pinot Noir Rosé (Tupungato)
description: This copper-tinted rosé of Pinot Noir smells like a rubber gym ball and citrus fruits.

title: Doña Paula 2009 Los Cardos Rosé Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Rosy pink and good for warm-climate getaways this winter.

title: Piattelli 2014 Premium Rosé of Malbec (Luján de Cuyo)
description: Aromas of powdered bubble gum, plum and chlorine aren't great, nor is the clamping, gritty feeling palate.

title: Melipal 2008 Rosé Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Raspberry and cherry aromas are light and pleasing, while the palate exhibits those same friendly and inviting raspberry flavors along with some citrus.

title: Finca Sophenia 2006 Altosur Cabernet Sauvignon (Tupungato)
description: Rather sweet and medicinal; the wine comes into form on the palate, which is fairly bright and forward as it pushes raspberry and cherry flavors.

title: Michel Torino 2007 Coleccion Chardonnay (Calchaquí Valley)
description: Light, floral and somewhat out of the mold.

title: Santa Julia 2007 Organica Chardonnay (Mendoza)
description: Round, nutty and smooth, with melon, citrus and apple flavors.

title: Zolo 2017 Sustainably Farmed Estate Grown and Bottled Torrontés (Mendoza)
description: Tropical aromas of lychee and honeydew set up a straightforward palate.

title: Aymara 2015 Estate Torrontés (Maipú)
description: Flat aromas of lanolin and oily white fruits lead to a round, full palate that's getting tired.

title: Benvenuto de la Serna 2015 Mil Piedras Viognier (Vista Flores)
description: Lime and tangerine aromas are light and dusty, with a yeasty note.

title: Cascada Peak 2012 Cabernet Sauvignon (Mendoza)
description: Cinnamon and licorice gumdrop and sketchy cherry cough drop aromas make up the nose on this cloying Cab that also shows hard tannins.

title: Carlos Basso 2006 Dos Fincas Cabernet Sauvignon-Merlot (Uco Valley)
description: Blackberry and cassis aromas share the bouquet with tougher, more masculine notes of earth, rubber and char.

title: Rutini 2012 Trumpeter Cabernet Sauvignon (Mendoza)
description: Gritty, roasted berry aromas are rubbery and hint at Band-Aids.

title: San Felipe 2012 Oak Cask Estate Bottled Cabernet Sauvignon (Mendoza)
description: Dry, spicy aromas aren't overly ripe or expressive.

title: Trapiche 2014 Oak Cask Cabernet Sauvignon (Mendoza)
description: Grassy stalky berry aromas lean towards green.

title: Casa Montes 2015 Ampakama Viognier (San Juan)
description: Briny, cidery aromas are a touch stale.

title: Valentin Bianchi 2015 Sensual Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Lightly spicy raspberry aromas are raw and peppery.

title: Trapiche 2014 Oak Cask Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Reedy green-leaning aromas of plum and raspberry feed into a creamy palate.

title: Aniello 2015 006 Riverside Estate Merlot (Patagonia)
description: Dry earthy herbal aromas of tomato, red-berry fruits and oak set up a full palate with pounding tannins.

title: Amalaya 2015 Esperanza Por Un Milagro White (Salta)
description: Oily aromas of citrus peel and lychee set up a lemony palate with pyrazine-influenced citrus flavors.

title: Doña Silvina 2006 Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Opens with rooty, baked aromas before finding its legs and plenty of ripe, attractive berry fruit.

title: Finca Vides 2009 Torcidas Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Solid and smooth from the beginning, with cola, pastry and blackberry aromas.

title: Los Vencejos 2010 Malbec (Uco Valley)
description: Floral hints, latex, vanilla, oak and ripe berry aromas all show up on a fine bouquet.

title: San Felipe 2013 Oak Cask Estate Bottled Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Damp, foresty, stalky aromas are backed by a chunky, slightly sticky feeling palate.

title: Alamos 2013 Red (Mendoza)
description: Aromas of blueberry and cinnamon smell odd and forced.

title: Black Box 2013 Malbec (Mendoza)
description: This is stalky, grassy and peppery smelling, with red-berry aromas.

title: Piattelli 2005 Premium Malbec (Luján de Cuyo)
description: Black plum, cola and chocolate define this textbook Malbec.

title: Ricominciare 2010 Malbec-Tannat (Uco Valley)
description: Initial plum and berry aromas fall off with airing and reveal notes of chemical and chewing gum dust.

title: Ricominciare 2011 Malbec-Cabernet Franc (Uco Valley)
description: Aromas of latex, plastic, clove and wild berry fruits try to come together.

title: Marchiori & Barraud 2007 Cuartel 2 Marchiori Vineyard Malbec (Perdriel)
description: Aggressive smelling early on but then it settles on classy raspberry, cassis and herbs.

title: Alpamanta 2009 Estate Malbec (Mendoza)
description: There's no denying the fact that this smells stalky and burnt, with leathery fruit aromas.

title: Casarena 2011 Estate Bottled Malbec (Mendoza)
description: This is exceedingly ripe tasting, with a syrupy texture.

title: Valentin Bianchi 2010 Famiglia Bianchi Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Pencil eraser, iodine, latex and blueberry aromas settle better than they start.

title: Domaine Bousquet 2016 Finca Lalande Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Racy plum and cherry aromas lead to an edgy palate with bold acidity.

title: Terrazas de Los Andes 2013 Reserva Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Strapping currant and berry aromas come with a full dosage of toasty oak.

title: Funky Llama 2007 Tempranillo (Mendoza)
description: Lightly brambled and ever so slightly green, with pleasant strawberry and raspberry aromas.

title: Riglos 2010 Gran Las Divas Vineyard Cabernet Franc (Tupungato)
description: Blackberry and cassis aromas blend seamlessly with varietal scents of herbs and leaves.

title: O. Fournier 2007 Urban Uco Tempranillo (Uco Valley)
description: Sharp, minty aromas mixed with stemmy red fruit set up a modest, middleweight palate of semisweet, generic red fruit flavors.

title: Doña Paula 2006 Los Cardos Syrah (Luján de Cuyo)
description: Mildly smoky and toasty aromas lead to a lightly oaked palate that's largely defined by black cherry and some rich berry syrup.

title: Ricominciare 2010 Altísimo Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Cherry, cassis and root beer aromas are appealing.

title: Viña Cobos 2015 Felino Malbec (Mendoza)
description: Earthy black-fruit aromas set up a rubbery, heavy palate with plenty of oak and related resin.

title: Recuerdo 2011 Malbec (Uco Valley)
description: Recuerdo is the house brand from the Vines of Mendoza project, which is relying on young Tupungato vineyards that expand annually.

title: Salentein 2005 Reserve Malbec (Uco Valley)
description: Earthy, deep and true to its Uco Valley roots; this is a very good and fairly serious Malbec that doesn't try to overstep its natural limitations.

title: Trivento 2005 Golden Reserve Malbec (Mendoza)
description: An intense, forward style of Malbec.
